calls.title: Adam & James
calls.summary: Adam Cheal will begin his role as Senior CRO Manager at Muse on August 3rd, focusing on leading global website conversion efforts during the company's shift towards an AI-native approach. He aims to streamline the experimentation process, aligning Muse’s tool stack with AI-driven goals, while assessing existing contracts and exploring alternative tools. Close collaboration with key internal figures like Tatiana and the website PM will be crucial, along with attending industry meetups for knowledge sharing. Adam plans to deploy advanced experimentation tools that empower non-technical users, with an aim to run proofs of concept by mid-August, reflecting a dedicated work towards modernizing Muse's experimentation capabilities.
calls.keywords: CRO, AI-native, experimentation, AB Tasty, Growthbook platform, Muse (Mews) transition
